artifacts.description: feat(io): write manifest.json through derived serde Serialize

acceptance_criteria: `crates/swx-io/Cargo.toml`: `serde = { version = "1", features = ["derive"] }`; the comment about Unicode-3.0 is removed.

`write_manifest` (and `read_manifest` where it makes the code simpler) uses derived `Serialize`/`Deserialize` types instead of building `serde_json::Value` by hand: `DocumentKind` with `#[serde(rename_all = "lowercase")]`, unknown fields kept through `#[serde(flatten)] extra` at the top level and in `units`, `model_hash` skipped when `None`. Every `FormatError` variant and field path from #184 stays exactly as it is.
All 18 existing `swx-io` tests pass unchanged (the golden file is still reproduced byte for byte), and no test is weakened or removed.

`docs/ARCHITECTURE.md`: one appended ADR line saying `swx-io` now builds `serde` with `derive`, so `serde_derive`, `syn`, `quote`, `proc-macro2` and `unicode-ident` (rows already in the register) are now built, and that Unicode-3.0 has been allowed since #198. Existing register rows are left as they are (FACTORY §8 allows only appended rows and ADR lines). Any other new transitive crate gets a new appended row with its license.
No `unsafe`, and `swx-io` still has no workspace dependencies.
`cargo fmt --all --check && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo test --workspace` pass.
QA report (FACTORY §6b) posted on the PR.
objective.description: M4-01c: swx-io: turn on serde derive for Manifest now that Unicode-3.0 is allowed
